app.name: KatWork
auth.panel.title: Your team of Kats is ready when you are.
auth.panel.kats: Kats are AI assistants that research, draft and check your documents.
auth.panel.trust: AI drafts and does a first check — you review and approve.
nav.sign_out_failed: Sign-out didn't finish, so you're still signed in.
login.title: Sign in
login.lede: Use the email and password your admin set up for you.
reset.request.title: Reset your password
reset.request.lede: Enter the email you sign in with. If it has an account, we'll send a link to choose a new password.
reset.request.sent: Check your inbox. If an account uses that email, a reset link is on its way. The link works once and expires in 30 minutes.
reset.confirm.title: Choose a new password
reset.confirm.lede: After the change you'll be signed out on every device. Then sign in with the new password.
reset.confirm.mismatch: The two passwords don't match. Type the same password in both fields.
reset.confirm.done: Password saved. Sign in with your new password.
invite.title: Set your password
invite.lede: You've been invited to KatWork. Choose a password to finish setting up your account, then sign in with your email and that password.
invite.mismatch: The two passwords don't match. Type the same password in both fields.
invite.done: Password set. Sign in with your email and your new password.
invite.no_token: This page needs the link you were sent. Open that link again: it works once and expires after 72 hours. If it no longer works, ask the person who manages KatWork to send you a new link.
home.title: Your team office
home.lede: Meet your team of Kats and pick up a conversation.
home.team.title: Team
home.chat.title: Chat
workspace.none: You're not in any workspace yet. Ask your admin to invite you.
workspace.no_space: This workspace has no Space yet. Ask your admin to add one.
team.title: Your team
team.lede: Kats are AI assistants. A message that mentions no one goes to the team lead; type @ and a Kat's name to ask that Kat directly.
team.none: This Space has no team yet. Ask your admin to set one up.
chat.empty: No messages yet. Say hello to your team to get started.
chat.composer_hint: Enter sends. Shift+Enter adds a new line. Type @ to mention a Kat.
chat.synthetic_hint: A sample reply from demo mode, not from an AI model.
chat.title: Conversations
chat.lede: Pick up a conversation, or start a new one with your team.
chat.no_threads: No conversations yet. Start one to talk to your team.
chat.polling: Live updates are paused because KatWork is open in many tabs. This page checks for new messages every 5 seconds.
chat.start: This is the start of the conversation.
members.title: Members
members.lede: The people who can use this workspace. Only owners and admins see this page.
members.name: Name
members.self_role_confirm: Change your own role to {role}? You may lose access to this page.
members.remove_confirm: Remove {name} from this workspace? They lose access at once. Their messages stay in the conversations.
members.removed: {name} was removed. Their messages stay in the conversations.
members.invite.title: Invite someone
members.invite.by_link: Copy a link and send it yourself
members.invite.email_unavailable: Email isn't set up on this KatWork server, so invites go by link.
members.invite.emailed: Invite sent to {email}. The link in it works once and expires after 72 hours.
members.invite.added: {email} already has a KatWork account, so they were added to this workspace. They sign in with their own password.
members.invite.link_hint: Send this link to them yourself. It works once, expires after 72 hours, and is shown only now.
members.invite.link_lost: Lost it? Whoever runs the KatWork server can make a new one with the reset-link command.
reason.provider_unavailable: The AI model service isn't responding right now. Try again in a few minutes.
reason.provider_rate_limited: The AI model service is busy. Try again in a minute.
reason.provider_quota: This workspace has used up its AI model allowance. Ask your admin to check the plan or budget.
reason.provider_auth_failed: The AI model service rejected KatWork's key. Ask your admin to check the model settings.
reason.model_protocol_error: The AI model sent a reply KatWork couldn't read. Try again.
reason.time_limit: The Kat ran out of time before finishing. Try a smaller request.
reason.too_many_requests: You sent too many requests to this Kat. Try again in a minute.
reason.quota_exceeded: This workspace has reached its usage limit for today. Try again tomorrow or ask your admin.
reason.workspace_paused: Your admin has paused the Kats in this workspace. The work waits until they're resumed.
reason.workspace_paused_stopped: Stopped because the Kats in this workspace were paused. Send the request again after they resume.
reason.kat_paused_stopped: Stopped because this Kat was paused. Send the request again after it resumes, or ask another Kat.
reason.step_limit: The Kat took too many steps without finishing. Try splitting the request into smaller parts.
reason.token_budget: The Kat used up its budget for this request. Try a shorter request.
reason.output_truncated: The reply was too long and got cut off. Ask for a shorter answer.
reason.residency_denied: This Space keeps its data on this server, and no local AI model is set up. Ask your admin to add one.
reason.loop_detected: The Kat kept repeating the same step, so KatWork stopped it. Rephrase the request and try again.
reason.policy_changed: The Kat's settings changed while it was working, so it stopped. Send the request again.
reason.approval_pending: This action needs approval. Approving actions is not available yet, so this request has ended.
reason.question_pending: A Kat asked you a question. Answer it to continue.
reason.interrupted_review_required: The work stopped partway after it had started changing things. Review what happened before trying again.
reason.kat_paused: That Kat is paused. Ask your admin to resume it, or ask another Kat.
reason.retries_exhausted: KatWork tried several times and couldn't finish. Try again later.
reason.outcome_unknown: A Kat started an action, but KatWork couldn't confirm whether it finished. Check the result before trying again.
reason.no_eligible_kat: No Kat in this team can take that request here. Check the team, or mention a Kat by name.
reason.kat_not_in_space: That Kat doesn't work in this Space. Ask your admin to add it.
reason.lease_lost: The Kat's work was interrupted. KatWork is picking it up again.
reason.unauthenticated: That email and password don't match. Check them and try again.
reason.reset_token_invalid: This reset link no longer works. Links work once and expire after 30 minutes. Request a new one.
reason.invite_token_invalid: This invite link no longer works. Invite links work once and expire after 72 hours. Ask the person who manages KatWork to send you a new link.
reason.password_invalid: Choose a password with at least 8 characters.
reason.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
reason.request_invalid: Something in the form isn't right. Check it and try again.
reason.body_too_large: That's too much to send at once. Shorten it and try again.
reason.auth_busy: Sign-in is busy right now. Try again in a moment.
reason.auth_failed: Sign-in isn't working right now. Try again in a moment.
reason.mail_delivery_failed: KatWork couldn't send the email. Ask your admin to check the mail settings.
reason.host_not_allowed: This KatWork server doesn't answer at this address. Open KatWork from its usual address.
reason.cross_site_request: This request came from another site, so KatWork blocked it. Open KatWork directly and try again.
reason.json_required: KatWork couldn't read that request. Reload the page and try again.
reason.database_unavailable: KatWork can't reach its database right now. Try again in a moment.
reason.database_error: Something went wrong while saving. Try again.
reason.not_found: That page or item doesn't exist.
reason.forbidden: Only workspace owners and admins can do that.
reason.member_exists: That person is already a member of this workspace.
reason.last_owner_required: A workspace needs at least one owner. Make someone else an owner first.
reason.smtp_unconfigured: Email isn't set up on this KatWork server, so the invite can't be mailed. Choose “Copy a link and send it yourself” instead.
reason.message_invalid: That message contains a character KatWork can't store. Remove it and try again.
reason.message_too_large: That message is too long. Split it into shorter messages.
reason.thread_title_invalid: Use a title of 120 characters or fewer, on one line, with no hidden characters.
reason.client_msg_id_conflict: This message was already sent with different text. Send it again as a new message.
reason.busy: KatWork is busy right now. Try again in a moment.
reason.too_many_streams: KatWork is open in too many tabs. Close a few tabs to get live updates again.
reason.network_error: Can't reach KatWork. Check your connection and try again.
